# fyre_vm_snapshots (Data Source)

Fetches the list of snapshots for a VM. The VM can be identified by VM ID (format: x-xxxxxxx), IP address, or fully qualified domain name (FQDN) that is in DNS.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (String) VM identifier (can be VM ID like '1-8103661', IP address, or FQDN in DNS)

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site location (svl or rtp). Defaults to 'svl' or inherits from provider configuration.
- `snapshot_count` (String) Number of snapshots currently created for this VM
- `snapshot_limit` (String) Maximum number of snapshots allowed for this VM
- `snapshots` (Attributes List) List of snapshots for the VM (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The VM identifier used for this data source

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Optional:

- `active` (String) Whether snapshot is active - 'true' or 'false' as string
- `comment` (String) Snapshot comment/description
- `created` (String) Snapshot creation timestamp
- `enabled` (String) Whether snapshot is enabled - 'y' or 'n'
- `full_snapshot` (String) Whether this is a full snapshot - 'true' or 'false' as string
- `name` (String) Snapshot name
- `used` (Number) Disk space used by snapshot in bytes
